sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Confused, depressed. Aches with a peculiar
periodical flushing of the face, even to the neck; dizzi-
ness and profound prostration.

sections.label: Nose
sections.text:
Foul-smelling discharge, membraneous for-
mations protruding. Post-nasal catarrh with ulceration
and fetor. Nose feels stuffed up. Right nostril raw,
bleeding.

sections.label: Mouth
sections.text:
Canker; gums recede and bleed easily;
corners of mouth and lips crack ; tongue dry and
swollen; sores; dirty brownish. Tongue, lips, and
fauces iingle, with sense of fear about heart. [Aeon.]
White coating of tongue, with red edges. Promotes
the flow of saliva.

308

sections.label: Throat
sections.text:
Tonsils purple or black, gray exudation
extending to posterior nares and air-passages. Ulcer-
ated sore throat.

sections.label: Stomach
sections.text:
Sour belching and heartburn. Nausea;
better lying down.

sections.label: Chest
sections.text:
Pain as of a lump in chest and under
sternum. Pain in pectoral muscles. [Aristolochia.]

sections.label: Urine
sections.text:
Albuminous, scanty, frequent, and invol-
untary.

sections.label: Female
sections.text:
Puerperal septicaemia; discharges sup-
pressed ; abdomen sensitive and tympanitic.

sections.label: Extremities
sections.text: Aching in limbs and general lassitude.

sections.label: Skin
sections.text:
Recurring boils. Carbuncles. Irritations
from insect bites and poisonous plants. Lymphatics en-
larged. Old tibial ulcers.

sections.label: Fever
sections.text: Chilliness^ wi*h nausea. Cold flashes all over
